name: BSP_HudMarker_ProjectUnitScreenBounds
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this=markers screen 4Dh, float3 anchorWorld by value, UnitInstance* unit, char* outCollapsed, float* outMinX, float* outMinY, float* outMaxX, float* outMaxY), RET 24h, body 0063A6C0..0063ABCD. Seeds the bounds with 00CE4970 (1e10) and 00CE4ADC (-1e10) and clears outCollapsed. Refreshes the pose (00414DB0), reads the world matrix rows at unit+DCh (up) and unit+ECh (forward), and for IsKindOf(6) without IsKindOf(8) raises the anchor by unit[538h][A8h] along up and doubles the up row (00D7A308). Then a triple loop over i,j,k in {-1,+1} builds eight corners anchor +- 0.5*[538h+A4h]*row0 +- 0.5*[538h+A8h]*row1 +- 0.5*[538h+A0h]*row2, projects each with 00638E50 and accumulates min/max of the screen x and y. A box narrower than this[88h]/1.5 is widened about its centre by 00CEC9E0 (-0.5); the y test uses the same margin scaled by 00CF5780 (1.33). When both axes were widened it reprojects the anchor alone, collapses all four bounds to that point and sets outCollapsed. Callers 00641910, 00642040, 00642C20. docs/HUD_MARKERS_RUNTIME.md. | Run-time evidence, bsp_game.exe milestone 2k: run over a created ship instance whose class record extents at [unit+538h]+A0h, +A4h and +A8h are all zero (only +A0h and +A8h have a recovered Lua key and both are zero for this installation's ships). The eight corners therefore collapse onto the anchor, both axes are widened by the this[88h]/1.5 rule, and 0063AB75's collapse path is the one that runs: the run reports collapsed=1 on every frame.
